text:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release=2026.03.04 env=prod-usw2. Starting post-deploy verifications: prefill, kvprobe, synth-heartbeat. canary=5% :white_check_mark:
amelia: Quick heads-up — eu1 prefill p95 jumped ~210ms -> ~3800ms around 4612345680. Seen in the prefills dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/prefill?ts=4612345680
ryan: I also see a few synth-heartbeat 5xx samples for embed-route (524) at the same window. Not many yet but correlated timestamps. logs snippet:
```
[4612345681] embed-route handler error: upstream read timeout (524) latency=12000ms
[4612345682] prefill eu1 p95=3800ms samples=118 kvcache_miss=0.12
```
amelia: traffic split note — ~10% of eu prefills went to model-quant2 variant (rolled with this deploy)
ops-bot: Automated mitigation: diverting 5% of eu1 prefill traffic to fallback-model at 4612345686. Routing change id=rt-2026-4612345686
ryan: My take: throttle the ramp for the rest of rollout (don't hard rollback) and pin eu routing to previous model variant while we triage. If error rate continues >1% for 10m, escalate to full rollback.
mark: +1 to throttling + quick triage. Rollback causes churn; prefer hold & pin unless it worsens. Can we also reduce embed batch_size for eu1 as a quick mitigation?
amelia: reducing batch_size from 32->16 for embed-route in eu1 makes sense, will push config hotpatch. Opening a ticket: INF-4023 (prefill p95 spike + synth 524).
amelia: INF-4023 details -> https://issues.redwood.internal/INF-4023 : note includes links to traces + sample requests
ryan: OK I'll watch logs and traces for next 15m. If 5xx persists above threshold, we'll revert model-quant2 via deploybot pin. For now: lower rollout to 30% and pin eu to prev-variant.
deploy-bot: Rollout adjusted: target=30% for prod-usw2 (eu1 subset). Applied pin: model=redwood-embed-v2@20260110 for eu1. Routing change id=rt-2026-4612345692.
amelia: hotpatch PR for batch_size posted: https://git.redwood/ops/patches/prefill-hotpatch PR#1287 — rolling to eu1 canary now.
mark: Thanks. Follow-up action items: 1) keep routing pin until INF-4023 triage complete, 2) monitor p95 & 5xx for 30m, 3) if stable, resume normal ramp, else rollback.
ryan: noted. Will post final decision in this thread after 15m check. :alarm_clock:
ops-bot: Monitoring probe started for INF-4023: metric p95_prefill_eu1 threshold=2000ms, error_rate_threshold=1% window=15m. Alert channel=#incidents if triggered.
ryan: 10m update — p95 back down to ~320ms after batch_size patch and routing tweak. 5xx sample count dropped to 0. Reasonable to hold and continue slow ramp.
amelia: good signal. Keep INF-4023 open until EOD for postmortem notes. I'll add a blameless-runbook section.
mark: closing loop here — no rollback. We'll retro notes into release notes and mention the quant2 variant is gated behind canary for next deploy. :thumbsup:
